name: AI UI Style Vault 3D Delivery Runtime Intelligence
principle: Consume the already-classified 3D interaction mode and use the smallest sufficient browser runtime. Asset format never determines the mode.

runtime.label: Google <model-viewer>
strengths: AR placement across supported device modes
environment lighting, shadows and tone mapping
custom DOM controls layered over the 3D view
escalateWhen: the experience requires a navigable multi-object world or room-scale scene graph
custom physics, game-like movement or complex object-object interaction is essential
the camera must follow a bespoke cinematic rail through a large scene
the experience requires arbitrary custom shaders/GPGPU or a deeply bespoke render pipeline
many independently interactive objects must coexist in one scene
digital-twin navigation, GIS-scale visualization or large spatial datasets exceed a bounded model-viewer experience
deescalateWhen: a still image, video, image sequence or DOM illustration communicates the same thing
the selected 3D mode is none or visual-only
the model is decorative and does not materially improve comprehension or conversion

profiles.label: Basic 3D Inspector
profiles.summary: Present one verified GLB/glTF model with bounded rotate/zoom inspection and a normal semantic product/content layout.
profiles.mobile: Keep touch-action compatible with page scroll, bound camera orbit, use a poster and defer model loading when the model is below the fold.
profiles.fallback: Approved product/object image carousel or poster with equivalent content and CTA.
avoid: unbounded orbit that loses the subject
using 3D as the only way to access essential product information

profiles.label: Annotated 3D Inspector
profiles.summary: Add semantic HTML hotspots, labels, dimensions or callouts to a verified model while keeping annotation copy accessible outside the renderer.
profiles.mobile: Keep labels short, prevent overlay collisions and provide a normal DOM list of the same annotations beneath or beside the model.
profiles.fallback: Annotated still image plus semantic feature/dimension list.
avoid: hotspots that disappear without an accessible equivalent

profiles.label: Variant Configurator Lite
profiles.summary: Use glTF material variants and bounded model transforms for a lightweight visual configurator when the option set is real and small.
profiles.mobile: Use native/semantic swatch controls outside the canvas, preserve a selected-state label and keep controls clear of software keyboards in WebXR.
profiles.fallback: Verified variant photography or swatch/image selector.
avoid: pretending visual variants are purchasable/available without commerce evidence
using scene-graph mutation when a simple material variant is sufficient

profiles.label: Animated Product/Object Viewer
profiles.summary: Play verified glTF animation clips for demonstrations, assembly steps or controlled object motion without building a full custom render loop.
profiles.mobile: Avoid autoplay when motion is distracting, expose simple play/pause controls and keep animations short enough to preserve responsiveness.
profiles.fallback: Video/image sequence or still-step explanation using the same verified content.
avoid: essential instructions that exist only inside an animation

profiles.label: AR Placement Preview
profiles.summary: Let users place a verified model in their physical space using supported WebXR, Scene Viewer or Quick Look modes with explicit capability/failure states.
profiles.mobile: Treat AR as an enhancement; show the AR action only when supported, guide scanning/placement, and keep a normal 3D or image experience available.
profiles.fallback: Normal model-viewer inspection or approved imagery when AR is unavailable or tracking fails.
avoid: AR for models with unverified dimensions
assuming WebXR DOM overlays transfer into native Scene Viewer or Quick Look
